Substitute Narrative and Plans for a Type |_ Rezoning of 3122 W. Belmont Avenue
from a C1-1 District to a B2-3 District

The subject property is improved with an asphalt parking area. The applicant
needs a zoning change to meet the bulk and density standards to build a 4-story mixed-
use building with nine dwelling units.

A. Proposed Land Use: Rezone from a C1-1 District to a B2-3 District to build a new 4-
story mixed-use building with nine dwelling units.
B. Project’s floor area ratio — FAR: 2.86
C. Project’s lot size is 5,827 SF and the density is 647 SF per dwelling unit — 9 dwelling
units.
D. The amount of off-street parking is 5 parking spaces.
E. Setbacks:
Front — 0°
Rear — 2’ at ground floor
- 30’ at floors 2-4
Side — 0’ — West
- 3° - East

F. The project building height will be 46-0”
